decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disrupt their game plan with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Dennick, Pious Apprentice. Utilizing powerful creatures like Skrelv, Defector Mite and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, as well as removal spells like Go for the Throat, the deck aims to establish a strong board presence and close out the game quickly. With a mix of creatures, control elements, and land cards that provide additional benefits, this Esper Aggro deck is designed to apply pressure and control the battlefield.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a low-cost, aggressive mono-blue strategy. By utilizing a mix of creatures with flying, countermagic, and card draw spells, it aims to control the tempo of the game while pressuring the opponent's life total. The deck's key strength lies in its ability to quickly establish a board presence and disrupt the opponent's plans through counterspells and removal spells, while also maintaining card advantage through draw spells. By efficiently managing resources and applying constant pressure, it aims to secure a fast victory against slower, less aggressive decks.

This Mono Black Control deck focuses on disrupting and controlling the opponent's resources while leveraging powerful creatures like Archfiend of the Dross and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to dominate the board. The deck includes removal spells like Infernal Grasp and Go for the Throat to deal with threats, as well as card draw options like Gruesome Realization and Invoke Despair to maintain card advantage. With a mix of removal, card advantage, and powerful creatures, this deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents in a slower, grindy matchup.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures and then bring them back into play using reanimation spells. By utilizing cards like Bloodtithe Harvester, Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, the deck can overwhelm opponents with big creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Atsushi, the Blazing Sky. The deck also includes removal spells like Cut Down and Go for the Throat to control the board and disrupt opponent's strategies. Overall, the deck aims to combo off and win through powerful reanimated creatures.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize a combination of control spells and creatures to dominate the battlefield. By using cards like Lay Down Arms and Ossification to immobilize opponents' creatures, as well as The Restoration of Eiganjo to protect your own, this deck aims to establish board control. Additionally, cards like Reckoner Bankbuster and Serra Paragon provide strong offensive options, while cards like Wedding Announcement and Elspeth Resplendent offer support and additional advantages. The deck also includes cards like The Wandering Emperor and Farewell for extra utility and flexibility in different situations.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and combat tricks to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes powerful creatures like Venerated Rotpriest and Slaughter Singer, as well as ways to pump up your creatures with cards like Tyvar's Stand and Audacity. The inclusion of cards like Destroy Evil and Crawling Chorus add removal and utility to the deck, while lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire provide protection and mana fixing. The goal is to apply constant pressure and outpace the opponent to secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful combo interactions to bring back powerful creatures from the graveyard, overwhelming opponents with creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester, Atsushi, the Blazing Sky, and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The deck also includes disruption spells like Duress and Go for the Throat to control the board. The mana base is built to support the combo pieces and provide flexibility for casting spells of different colors. Overall, the deck aims to quickly generate a strong board presence and close out games efficiently.

The deck focuses on utilizing graveyard recursion and powerful combo pieces to overwhelm opponents. By filling the graveyard with creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and utilizing cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, the deck can quickly reanimate threats like Atsushi, the Blazing Sky and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. Atraxa, Grand Unifier helps to support the reanimation strategy by providing additional value when creatures enter the battlefield. The deck also includes removal spells like Cut Down and Go for the Throat to handle opposing threats while maintaining pressure on the opponent.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing a variety of removal spells and counterspells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also includes cards that provide card advantage and board control, such as Herd Migration and Leyline Binding. The deck aims to maintain board presence while slowly building up resources and ultimately overwhelming the opponent with powerful late-game threats like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. It also features a diverse mana base to ensure consistent access to different colors of mana for casting spells effectively.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures with a mix of control elements. It aims to apply pressure early with efficient creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Dennick, Pious Apprentice, while also using removal spells like Go for the Throat to control the board. With a mix of flying creatures and powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, the deck looks to quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory. The land base is designed to support a mix of white, blue, and black mana sources to ensure consistency in casting spells.

This deck focuses on a combination of aggressive creatures and disruption spells to apply pressure on the opponent while controlling the board. By playing efficient creatures like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, and using removal spells like Go for the Throat, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Gix, Yawgmoth Praetor and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provides additional threats that can help close out the game. With a mix of disruption, aggression, and powerful creatures, this deck aims to win by outpacing the opponent and controlling the game.

The main focus of this deck is to establish early board control and pressure the opponent with a quick and aggressive gameplay style. Using a mix of efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Haughty Djinn, along with disruptive spells like Make Disappear and Slip Out the Back, the deck aims to keep the opponent on the back foot while constantly applying pressure. By maintaining a low mana curve and focusing on tempo plays, the Mono Blue Aggro deck looks to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own board presence.

This aggressive Rakdos deck focuses on quick creature removal and disruption while utilizing powerful creatures like Ob Nixilis and Liliana of the Veil to control the board. Mishra's Research Desk and Oni-Cult Anvil help draw cards and keep up the pressure, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can buff the team. Razorlash Transmogrant provides additional removal options, and Bloodtithe Harvester can gain valuable life points. The deck is supported by a strong land base and is designed to overwhelm opponents with a combination of creature threats and efficient removal spells.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive red creatures like Bloodthirsty Adversary, Monastery Swiftspear, and Kumano Faces Kakkazan, supported by efficient burn spells like Lightning Strike and Play with Fire. The deck aims to maintain a fast pace and apply constant pressure, using cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Squee, Dubious Monarch for added value. Feldon, Ronom Excavator and Phoenix Chick provide additional threats and utility, while cards like Thundering Raiju and Mishra's Foundry help to ensure consistent mana production.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly build a board presence by playing low-cost creatures and using spells that support and protect them. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with a steady stream of creatures while also providing some control options with spells like Ossification and Generous Visitor. With a mix of creatures that provide value and protection, alongside spells that help with card draw and mana ramp, this deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain a strong presence on the battlefield throughout the game.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures and powerful combat tricks to overwhelm the opponent quickly. By playing efficient creatures like Jawbone Duelist and Venerated Rotpriest, combined with combat enhancers like Destroy Evil and Audacity, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early on. Support cards like Crawling Chorus and Skrelv's Hive help to maintain board presence and deal damage consistently. With a mix of green and white mana sources, the deck ensures it can cast its spells effectively while utilizing powerful lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire for added value.
